title: Affine-local universal first order thickening construction
statement: For a formally unramified morphism h : Z ⟶ X of schemes, there exist Z', i and h' with IsFirstOrderThickening i, i ≫ h' = h, and the universal lifting property for affine test schemes T and T'.

proof.text: Construct the square-zero thickenings on an affine open cover and glue them using uniqueness on overlaps; verify lifting for affine tests.

lean.statement: theorem FormallyUnramified.exists_affine_local_universalFirstOrderThickening {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X) [FormallyUnramified h] : ∃ (Z' : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ Z') (h' : Z' ⟶ X), IsFirstOrderThickening i ∧ i ≫ h' = h ∧ ∀ {T T' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] [IsAffine T'] (j : T ⟶ T') (b : T' ⟶ X) (a : T ⟶ Z), IsFirstOrderThickening j → j ≫ b = a ≫ h → ∃! a' : T' ⟶ Z', a' ≫ h' = b ∧ j ≫ a' = a ≫ i
